steps.text: Good morning ❤️ I've lost an earring and somehow decided it's your fault, how's your morning going?
That is an impressive accusation before breakfast
I was reading your messages while putting them on
Then I laughed, dropped one, and now I have one very elegant ear
Let me see the damage
You sound much too pleased about this
I see the problem
Finally
You still look beautiful, which weakens your case against me
That was suspiciously smooth for someone who's just woken up
I've been awake a while
Couldn't sleep?
I woke up early and couldn't get comfortable again
Nothing dramatic, just an argument with the pillows
You could have messaged me
You would have answered and then blamed me for being tired
That's completely different from blaming you for jewelry
Of course
Wait, found it
It was caught in my sleeve the entire time
I'd like that apology in writing
Dear handsome, I regret that the evidence failed to support my very reasonable accusation
Accepted
Excellent, now help me decide whether these look all right together
2 MINUTES LATER
Both earrings, both shoes, actual lecture notes in the bag
Very convincing impression of a woman who has her life together
Thank you, it took several attempts
And yes, they look good together
Good, because I'm not changing again
You were never going to listen to me, were you
Not if you were wrong 😌
How are you feeling about today?
I messaged {{name:aiden}} before I started getting ready
Asked if he had a few minutes after class
What did he say?
Yes, and then he asked whether he should bring the notes he borrowed
At least he remembers
He still has no idea what I want to talk about
Which is making me want to explain the entire thing by text just to get the first sentence over with
Would that actually make it easier?
For about ten seconds
Then I'd spend the whole morning wondering whether he was laughing at his phone
You're allowed to open with something awkward
I know, but I was hoping to skip straight to being charming
You managed with me
You were an unusually forgiving audience ❤️
You had me at the first insult
Then perhaps I should start by telling him he's annoying
He might not realize this is a special conversation
Exactly my concern
I'll talk to him properly after class, before I give myself another excuse
I published the profile
Already?
Before I could rewrite the introduction for the sixth time
The photo from last night, the bit about being in a relationship, and my very attractive pasta problem
A strong introduction
I added that I mean a real coffee in a real café, not someone inviting himself to my place
That sounds like you
I put the phone face down afterward like it might start giving me instructions
You know you don't have to answer anything during class
I do, and I'm leaving it alone until my break
Mostly because I don't want my first reply to contain a sentence from today's lecture
Depends on the lecture
No man deserves my notes on research methods as an introduction
You might find someone with very specific interests
I already have one of those 😌
Fair enough
It feels strange that it's actually there now
But I'm glad I pressed the button instead of spending another day adjusting commas
What time do you finish?
Around lunch, unless someone discovers a question just as we're leaving
And I have a book to return before the library starts sending me threateningly polite emails
A busy day of facing your enemies
You, university, the library
I'm on the list?
You made me miss you while I was trying to get dressed
You're welcome
That wasn't a thank you
I put your pasta in a separate container, by the way
So now I have a very practical reason to come over soon
You already have several very impractical ones
Those are my favorites ❤️
Okay, leaving now before I start another conversation with you
Good luck today
Thank you, handsome
And have some breakfast that didn't come out of a packet next to the console
You've narrowed down my options considerably
